message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "The disease shows an initial spread of nodular densities in the middle and lower lung fields, which later progresses to diffuse bilateral involvement with extensive infiltrative lesions and radiolucencies.", "reason": "Visual inspection of the chronological series (Figure 1a: 1993, Figure 3a: 2000, Figure 4a: 2000, Figure 6a: 2004) demonstrates a clear progression from discrete nodular opacities concentrated in the mid-to-lower zones to widespread, confluent bilateral infiltrates with increasing density and heterogeneity (radiolucencies), consistent with advanced bronchioloalveolar carcinoma.
